title: D05-W03 Segmentation refresh — packaged from historical exec #69
body: Proposed behavioural segment classification from Klaviyo Checkout Started vs Placed Order aggregates. Segment size is the observed event gap (43), not a measured live segment membership count. Klaviyo evidence is not Shopify customer-source evidence.

items.title: checkout_started_not_purchased
items.body: Definition: profiles/events showing Checkout Started without corresponding Placed Order in the observed aggregate window. Basis metrics: Checkout Started (SpKS9Q) total=136, Placed Order (Rem3fY) total=93, gap=43 over 2026-07-01..2026-09-05 US/Eastern. Existing segment inventory observed: Bounced emails (RknMBR, profile-metric), Newsletter True (UdNC8Z, profile-marketing-consent). Do not mutate segments.
